# Checks a release commit must have passed (conclusion success, from GitHub Actions) before
# tag-release.yml tags it. One name per line, written exactly as the check appears on a commit
# (matrix values included). This is the union of the checks the rulesets of main and next require,
# plus the Node.js unit suite on Windows (windows-paths.yml), which runs on every push to a release branch.
# .github/scripts/release-required-checks.mjs lint fails when a name here matches no job in
# .github/workflows; when the rulesets change, change this list in the same pull request.
Node.js 18.x tests & benchmarks
Node.js 22.x tests & benchmarks
Node.js 24.x tests & benchmarks
Python 3.12 tests & benchmarks (ubuntu-latest)
Python package (build, twine check, install)
npm package (pack, inspect, install)
leak bench (node 22 / ubuntu-latest)
scrubber + vault (node 22 / ubuntu-latest)
Lint (eslint, ruff, mypy)
Windows (Node.js 22)
Public facts
build, test, clippy, fmt
